title: Kite Season
logline: A boy who broke a kite has two days to help build a better one — and to decide whether to admit it.
setting: A small Konkan-coast town in the week of its kite festival. Monsoon is over; the sea wind is back.
history: Ira's father built festival kites for twenty years. This is the first kite she has made without him.
culture: Everyone knows everyone. The repair shop is where kids trade parts, gossip and favours.
rules: Ordinary world. Kites fly or fall on bamboo, paper, line and luck.
themes: letting go of a parent's shadow
art_direction: Soft painted anime with warm afternoon light, teal sea, saffron and coral festival colours, clean line art.
music_direction: Light acoustic guitar, flute and hand percussion, rising to strings on festival day.
